notes.title: Pricing Update
notes.notes: Hello, the lone developer of Secrets Under Eco here. After reading the reviews that SUE has received up to this point and completely agreeing with them, I have decided to make the game free to play. It's hard to justify charging money in its current state, and there are no planned updates as of right now. I put a lot of time and passion into this game, and I'm so immensely grateful to anyone that has given this game any of their precious time.
